M1.name: Spirit:
M1.text: Mom! Can I go dance with the other kids?

M2.name: Spirit:
M2.text: The whole community is here and united, thanks to the king. Such a wonderful and joyous day!

M3.name: Spirit:
M3.text: Another great harvest festival. The king has done it again! Long live the king! Hip hip!

S1.name: Spirit:
S1.text: This years harvest is so thin....

S2.name: Spirit:
S2.text: Not only are there barely any crops, but most of them are spoiled!

S2.name: Spirit:
S2.text: How can we eat this? How can we survive?
